value.rationale: This natural first 2-adic doubling of the 4k short-period window is a structural period-doubling obstruction, beyond known 5-, 6- and 7-multiple exclusions. The theorem proves all 8k fixed points already belong to the known 4k sector and identifies a rigid 4-core finite-state mechanism, yielding complete exact enumeration for an otherwise larger fixed set. It is not a routine substitution into Finch’s 4k formula and has meaningful scope for all lag lengths.
